title: RepoMesh AgentTeams Task Package v2 Manifest
description: manifest.json at the root of one attempt directory. It lists every file the platform published (never manifest.json itself, never the worker's candidate/ or copaw's result.md) and pins their digests. content_hash is the sha256 of the concatenation of "<path>\0<digest>\n" over files in sorted order; a publisher that finds an existing manifest compares this value and either replays (equal) or refuses (different).

attempt_id.description: Equals the directory name (D-8) and meta.json.task_id (D-6).

files.description: Sorted, posix-separated relative paths. Must contain meta.json and spec.md; may contain base/** and review/**. Every entry has a digest and a size.
